        inc r0

name: kept-sieve

.equ LIMIT, 50
.data
flags:  .space LIMIT+1, 1
.text
main:   mov r0, 2
outer:  mov r1, r0
        mul r1, r0
        cmp r1, LIMIT
        jg report
        mov r2, [flags+r0]
        cmp r2, 0
        je nexto
inner:  cmp r1, LIMIT
        jg nexto
        mov r3, 0
        mov [flags+r1], r3
        add r1, r0
        jmp inner
nexto:  inc r0
        jmp outer
report: mov r0, 2
rl:     cmp r0, LIMIT
        jg fin
        mov r2, [flags+r0]
        cmp r2, 0
        je skip
        out r0
skip:   inc r0
        jmp rl
fin:    halt
